name: Trend Report
tagline: Complete 18-page Trend Report display system with its own typography, composition and layout vocabulary.

palette.description: Purple gradients, white/lavender panels, cyan and pink data accents, and chrome illustrations with curved-grid backgrounds.

typography.style: Poppins Black uppercase headings and Poppins body copy, with Inter chart labels. The source-declared Abril Fatface theme face is also embedded. Original families, sizes, weights, tracking and source composition are retained; all embedded files retain OFL notices.

best_for: Trend reports, survey findings, market signals and research narratives that connect evidence, segmented comparisons, implications and recommendations.
avoid_for: Low-key formal board reporting, long technical specifications, or dense datasets that cannot be split into the existing chart and cell layouts.

source_inspiration.notes: Full 18-page native display adaptation of Pitch Trend Report. This completes the missing sixth admission from the historical October 28 batch. Slide-level background-image semantics, gradient panels, chrome graphics and all layout variants are retained. Four charts are independently rebuilt as editable SVG with adjacent JSON; the source data-table layout uses editable individual cells and shapes. Fonts retain their OFL licenses; source media are provenance-recorded without asserting blanket clearance.
